name: foundation-ts
description: Typescript basic manipulation functions and classes

scripts.fsbase: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && node tdist/test/build_standard_paths.js
scripts.pack: npm run clean && npm run build && node dist/SetupPackage.js && cd dist && npm pack
scripts.publish: npm run clean && npm run build && node dist/SetupPackage.js && cd dist && npm pack && npm publish
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && node --async-stack-traces --experimental-modules --no-warnings tdist/test/index.test.js
scripts.coverage: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && c8 node --async-stack-traces --no-warnings tdist/test/index.test.js
scripts.test:jsdom: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && node -r ./test/jsdom-register.cjs --async-stack-traces --no-warnings tdist/test/jsdom.test.js
scripts.test:chrome: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && node test/browser-build.mjs && node test/browser-driver.mjs chromium
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && node test/browser-build.mjs && node test/browser-driver.mjs firefox
scripts.test:webkit: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && node test/browser-build.mjs && node test/browser-driver.mjs webkit
scripts.test:browsers: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && node test/browser-build.mjs && node test/browser-driver.mjs chromium && node test/browser-driver.mjs firefox && node test/browser-driver.mjs webkit
scripts.test:all: npm run clean && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && cp -R src/*.json tdist/src && node --async-stack-traces --experimental-modules --no-warnings tdist/test/index.test.js && node -r ./test/jsdom-register.cjs --async-stack-traces --no-warnings tdist/test/jsdom.test.js && node test/browser-build.mjs && node test/browser-driver.mjs chromium && node test/browser-driver.mjs firefox && node test/browser-driver.mjs webkit
